awards.description: Presented to 16 students across YRDSB that personify excellence through a combination of character, leadership and service to the school and/or community.

posts.text: Now that I’ve wrapped up my co-op at Hennick Humber Hospital Foundation, I’ve been reflecting on how much this experience shaped the way I approach problem-solving. During my term, I developed two AI prototypes. One was a chatbot designed to sit on top of the IT Help Desk ticketing system and the other was a voice-based facilitator for the hospital’s locating services.
